sentences: Sami and Eli were in different houses.
Eli and Dev were in different houses.
Sami and Dev were in different houses.
contradictions.explanation: With only three houses and five members, having Sami, Eli, and Dev all pairwise in different houses accounts for all three houses, but this creates no contradiction by itself unless combined with Xavi and Lena also needing distinct houses among only three, forcing overlaps that violate the stated pairwise differences.

sentences: Dev mentioned he was the tallest of the group, though Eli insisted he had grown taller over the summer.
contradictions.explanation: Dev cannot be the tallest of the group while Eli is asserted to have grown taller than him.
